assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, a side-view 2D industrial science fiction game. New original asset, not an edit. Reference image is a visual material/style reference only, not a target to copy.
Create exactly SIXTEEN individual modular parts in a strict 4-column by 4-row square sprite sheet. Transparent background with real clean alpha, no colored backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no cell borders. Each item fully inside its own cell with generous clear margins. Crisp painted realist game art, weathered dark sage-green armor, muted brass hardware, pale worn edges and small restrained amber/green indicator lights. Strict orthographic broadside view, no three-quarter camera, no perspective turn. The machine is PRETOIRE, a low wide original corporate security quadruped, not the red reference biped. Design a squat faceted armored central body, four separate articulated legs assembled later by game code.
Read cells LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
Row 1: (1) normal armored body facing LEFT, (2) same body attacking, restrained amber indicator changes, (3) same body with a front armor hatch torn away exposing mechanism, (4) same body wrecked and dark. All FOUR BODIES MUST HAVE NO LEGS, NO CANNON/BARREL, NO TOP SENSOR and NO FRONT EXTERNAL PISTON. Same silhouette scale and alignment. Only the broad body with mounting sockets.
Row 2: (5) isolated upper leg segment, horizontal, round pivot at left and at right, (6) isolated lower leg segment horizontal with round joints at both ends, (7) isolated low wide armored foot seen from the side with ankle socket above and flat sole below, toe points RIGHT, (8) isolated circular hip joint facing the viewer.
Row 3: (9) isolated circular knee joint facing the viewer, (10) isolated short heavy cannon side-view pointing LEFT with a large round pivot at the RIGHT and muzzle at the LEFT, no body attached, (11) isolated small upper optical sensor pod tracking, round glass eye directed LEFT and short pedestal below, (12) same sensor locking, amber eye, identical scale.
Row 4: (13) same sensor destroyed/dark with cracked lens, (14) isolated upright front hydraulic locking piston with armored mounting bracket, intact, (15) same locking piston broken with severed rod and exposed cable, (16) the same short cannon from cell10 in a damaged/dark state for reference, identical scale.
Every cell contains ONE part only. No duplicate assembled walker anywhere. The first row bodies are about twice as wide as high. Lower parts may use larger individual cell scale for detailed cutouts. Keep all repeated bodies, sensors, pistons and cannons identically scaled and centered within their own cells. Visually match the reference's sharp edge wear and believable painted mechanical detail but use olive/sage corporate color, no recognizable franchise design. Deliver one square transparent PNG atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D game sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE. Reference is MATERIAL AND PAINTING STYLE ONLY.
Create one production atlas containing exactly SIX states of the SAME industrial data relay mast, strict THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS. Canvas landscape, actual transparent background, no backdrop or floor, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grids. Each mast isolated wholly inside its cell with 8 percent transparent margins. Each version identical camera, proportions, scale, centered base and overall alignment.
The original relay design: tall weathered sage-green metal lattice tower on a compact heavy trapezoid base, broad armored archive cabinet halfway up, small directional communications aerial and angled flat dish at its top, looped cable descending on the right. Front/side orthographic sprite, nearly flat elevation suitable for a side-scrolling sci-fi world. Restrained dark teal screen, dull brass brackets and screws, chipped ivory edges. Same gritty realistic painted-detail language as supplied control-console reference, no copying its shape.
Reading left to right then next row:
1 LIVE: intact mast and aerial, dim green data bars inside cabinet, green lens near top.
2 REVIEWED: same intact mast, small pale green physical inspection tag clipped to cabinet.
3 PURGING: same intact mast, restrained amber data bars and amber warning light on cabinet, no big special effect, no explosion.
4 ISOLATED: same intact mast, visibly unplugged cable with short disconnected connector and hanging pale brass isolation padlock, dark screen, amber small top lens.
5 ERASED: same intact but dark mast, inert black-green display, all data lights off, aerial still physically present.
6 DESTROYED: same base and lower structure, broken bent aerial mast, shattered cabinet and exposed wiring, a few wreck fragments tightly beside base, no smoke, no flame.
All six are individual transparent sprite cutouts. Do not include extra wires between cells, people, terrain or buildings. No stylized cartoon outlines, no rectangular background. Keep comparable silhouette extents except realistic broken top in state6.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE 2D side-scrolling game. The supplied control console is a material/style reference only.
Create exactly EIGHT isolated console props, a strict FOUR-COLUMN TWO-ROW landscape sprite atlas on REAL transparent alpha background. No background, floor, cast shadows, labels, text, cell borders or people. All objects entirely within cells with generous clear gutters.
Visual language: crisp realistic painted industrial sci-fi sprites, weathered sage-green enameled steel, muted brass bolts, chipped pale edges, subtle dark green CRT screens, amber status lamps. Orthographic front/side elevation suitable for 2D game, no dramatic camera perspective. Match reference gritty materials but make new original hardware.
ROW1 four states of the SAME short wide data-copy terminal: wide sloping armored monitor/control desk on sturdy short central pedestal, thick removable data canister on right, cable looping down, rectangular base. Each terminal same exact scale, base, screen and cable positions.
Column1 idle dark green monitor with sparse pale data bars; column2 copying with restrained amber data bars and indicator lit, no written words; column3 copied with green lamp and completed solid green bars, data canister still attached; column4 expired with dark monitor and a small dim amber warning light, NOT destroyed.
ROW2: columns1–3 three states of the SAME slim radio command-post: narrow tall armored keypad console with short right-side antenna and pedestal base, visually clearly distinct from row1 terminal, same scale across these three. Column1 idle with dark screen; column2 working with restrained amber indicator/data lines; column3 transmitted with bright small green status lamp and pale green data bars. Column4 isolated removable rugged brass-and-sage data cassette, alone, a reference prop.
Transparent cutouts only; do not bake a progress percentage or bar filling into arbitrary states except static screen data, the game draws actual progress separately. No explosions, no lighting background, no checkerboard pattern painted behind objects.
